subject: Recap — inference pilot fit + small readiness ask
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@dataspring.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap — inference pilot fit + small readiness ask

Hi Samir — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and a very small next-step ask so we can keep momentum: 

Summary (3 bullets):
- Main need: real-time product-recommendation scoring at 200–400 QPS with <150ms p95 inference latency.
- Workload: 2–3 short prompt templates, one long context (customer history) occasionally appended.
- Success metrics: latency under 150ms p95 in prod; cost target ~25% below current vendor.

What I can deliver by Wednesday: a short "Discovery snapshot" (attached) with a suggested pilot scope, target SLAs, and an initial cost estimate.

Micro-commit ask: Can you introduce me to the infra/ML platform person who would own a pilot (or, if it's you, confirm you can 15-min review the snapshot)? A 10–15 min micro-commit is all we need to validate operational readiness.

If helpful, proposed slots: Wed 6/23 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 6/24 14:00–14:30 PT — I can calendar one once I have the right attendee.

Attachment: redwood-discovery-snapshot.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — appreciate the time. If the timing is off, a quick reply with the right owner name/email works too.

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Ben — forwarding the thread. No reply from Samir yet. Thinking of trying one of two options: (A) ask you to make a 1-line intro to their infra lead (your note + me cc'd) because we had good resonance on cost/latency; or (B) move this to an informal competitive check-in (quick call) to surface timing. Which would you prefer?

If you want to take option A, here's a suggested intro you can paste: 

Hi Samir — picking up from Grace's note below. Grace and the Redwood team have a practical pilot plan and a short readiness checklist that should take 10–15m to validate. Grace — can you and I get the infra lead on a brief sync next week to confirm capacity constraints?

No rush — thought I'd check before I escalate.

—
Grace
